import numpy as np

import casa_tool

class Controller:
    def __init__(self, session):
        self.s = session
        self.m, self.d = session.model, session.data
        self.k = mujoco.MjData(self.m)  # separate, read-only planning state
        self.jids = np.array([self.m.joint(f'robot0_joint{i}').id for i in range(1,8)])
        self.qids = self.m.jnt_qposadr[self.jids]
        self.dids = self.m.jnt_dofadr[self.jids]
        self.limits = self.m.jnt_range[self.jids]
        self.site = self.m.site('gripper0_right_grip_site').id
        self.base = self.m.body('mobilebase0_support').id
        self.a = session.initial_command()
        self.down = np.array([[0.,1.,0.],[1.,0.,0.],[0.,0.,-1.]])

    def pose(self):
        return self.d.site_xpos[self.site].copy(), self.d.site_xmat[self.site].reshape(3,3).copy()

    def ik(self, pos, rot, seed=None):
        self.k.qpos[:] = self.d.qpos
        q = self.a[:7].copy() if seed is None else np.array(seed).copy()
        jp, jr = np.zeros((3,self.m.nv)), np.zeros((3,self.m.nv))
        for _ in range(100):
            self.k.qpos[self.qids] = q
            mujoco.mj_kinematics(self.m,self.k)
            mujoco.mj_comPos(self.m,self.k)
            ep = np.asarray(pos) - self.k.site_xpos[self.site]
            er = Rotation.from_matrix(rot @ self.k.site_xmat[self.site].reshape(3,3).T).as_rotvec()
            if np.linalg.norm(ep) < 0.0001 and np.linalg.norm(er) < 0.0005:
                break
            mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,self.k,jp,jr,self.site)
            J = np.vstack((jp[:,self.dids], .35*jr[:,self.dids]))
            e = np.r_[ep,.35*er]
            dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J@J.T + .0001*np.eye(6),e)
            q += dq * min(1.,.12/(np.max(np.abs(dq))+1e-12))
            q = np.clip(q,self.limits[:,0]+.01,self.limits[:,1]-.01)
        return q, np.linalg.norm(ep), np.linalg.norm(er)

    def step(self, q=None, grip=None, base=None, torso=0, mode=-1):

        for _ in range(n): self.step(grip=grip)

    def move(self, pos, rot=None, n=60, grip=None, settle=10):
        p0,r0 = self.pose()
        rot = r0 if rot is None else np.asarray(rot)
        delta = Rotation.from_matrix(rot @ r0.T).as_rotvec()
        for i in range(n):
